findings.issue: lib/auth.ts: PrismaAdapter(db) cast to `any` — defeats TypeScript type safety and could mask adapter/Prisma version incompatibilities at runtime

findings.issue: research/route.ts: `session: any` and projects/route.ts: `session: any` — session objects typed as `any` leak through multiple route handlers

findings.recommendation: Centralize the type assertion in lib/rbac.ts withAuth function
